integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity identifies it with ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: Independent row and column rescaling preserves every matrix Schubert variety; a generic one-parameter subgroup with distinct coordinate weights has coordinate matrices as the only projective fixed points.
integrity.membership_basis: A coordinate matrix E_ij satisfies all rank conditions exactly when r_w(i,j) is positive, equivalently when i is at least the prefix minimum m_j.
integrity.object_basis: The source defines matrix Schubert varieties by northwest rank conditions and identifies them as B x B_+ orbit closures.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source is in math.AG and lists MSC 14M12 and 14M15 among its classifications; 14M15 is used here.

scientific_limitations: The theorem gives ordinary Euler characteristic only and does not determine degree, singularities, Betti numbers, or Hilbert series.
It concerns the projectivized affine matrix Schubert cone rather than the Schubert variety in the flag variety.
The localization argument is short, so an older unindexed observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of a projective matrix Schubert variety is a prefix-minimum statistic
